game.desc: If there is no longer any question of Billy in this new Call of Juarez on Xbox 360, you will still find the Reverend Ray McCall this time flanked by his brother. Once again, horseback riding will follow duels in the great tradition of the Wild West, interspersed with muscular encounters with Indians and Southerners.
